items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2 (widely available) and Mythos 5.2 (restricted via verification programs) as its most capable models for technical work in coding, finance, and sciences. Pricing is $8/$40 per million tokens (20% below 5.1).
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.2（廣泛可用）與 Mythos 5.2（透過驗證計畫限制存取），定位為技術工作（編碼、金融、科學）最強力模型。定價為每百萬 token $8/$40（較 5.1 低 20%）。
items_flat.analysis_en: The dual release continues Anthropic’s pattern of tiered access for high-capability models with stronger safeguards on the open version. Early enterprise uptake and independent coding benchmarks will determine whether the claimed gains hold in practice.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 雙版本發布延續 Anthropic 對高能力模型分層存取的模式，開放版本強化安全機制。早期企業採用與獨立編碼基準將決定宣稱的提升是否能在實務中成立。
items_flat.quote: We’ve upgraded Claude Fable and Claude Mythos—models that are designed to tackle the most daunting technical challenges.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們已升級Claude Fable與Claude Mythos——專為應對最艱鉅技術挑戰而設計的模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for secure agent purchases
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet，讓代理安全完成購買
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, allowing dots (agents) to complete web purchases for US ChatGPT Pro users aged 18+ without accessing real card details. Each transaction requires biometric approval (e.g., Face ID), built with Amex, Mastercard, and Visa.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet，讓 dots（代理）為美國 18 歲以上 ChatGPT Pro 使用者完成網路購買，而不接觸真實卡號。每筆交易需生物辨識核准（如 Face ID），與 Amex、Mastercard、Visa 合作打造。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves agents from recommendation to actual commerce with strong user controls and network-token isolation. Early US Pro-only rollout and biometric friction will test adoption versus convenience.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這讓代理從推薦轉向實際商務，並具備強力使用者控制與網路 token 隔離。早期僅限美國 Pro 與生物辨識摩擦將考驗採用與便利性的平衡。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing ChatGPT Wallet, setting a new bar for secure payments by agents. It’s the first wallet that lets agents pay without access to users’ actual card details and that requires a security check for every purchase.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出ChatGPT Wallet，為代理安全支付設立新標準。這是第一個讓代理在不接觸用戶實際卡片資料的情況下付款、且每筆購買都需安全檢查的錢包。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday agentic work
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，用於日常代理工作
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Hydrogen as a fast, efficient model for coding and agentic workflows, priced at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens flat across 1M context. It is rolling out to the Gemini API, AI Studio, Search, and paid Antigravity.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，定位為快速高效的編碼與代理工作流程模型，定價為每百萬 token $1.50/$7.50（1M 上下文統一價格）。正逐步上線至 Gemini API、AI Studio、Search 與付費 Antigravity。
items_flat.analysis_en: Hydrogen fills the high-volume/speed tier below Carbon and Argon, aiming to make Gemini 4 widely usable. Independent benchmarks will determine if the claimed speed and quality edge holds versus peers.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Hydrogen 填補 Carbon 與 Argon 之下的高用量／速度層級，目標讓 Gemini 4 更廣泛可用。獨立基準將決定其速度與品質優勢是否成立。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，將尖端智慧帶給所有人——為日常程式設計與代理工作流提供速度與效率。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow targeting up to ~$1.4T valuation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 啟動 IPO 路演，目標估值最高約 1.4 兆美元
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its proposed Class A common stock IPO on Nasdaq under the symbol ANT. The offering prices shares at $70–$78, with expected pricing around November 18 and trading around November 19, plus a concurrent private placement.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 啟動擬議 Class A 普通股 IPO 路演，計畫於 Nasdaq 以 ANT 代號上市。股價區間 $70–$78，預計約 11 月 18 日定價、19 日交易，並有同步私人配售。
items_flat.analysis_en: The roadshow tests public-market appetite for frontier AI after the SpaceX listing. Reported oversubscription supports the upper end of the range, but final pricing and aftermarket performance remain uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 路演測試公開市場對前沿 AI 的興趣（在 SpaceX 上市之後）。據報超額認購支持區間上限，但最終定價與上市後表現仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天Anthropic, PBC啟動其擬議的A類普通股首次公開發行路演。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches science blog with GPT-6 Astra lattice Standard Model work
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出科學部落格，首篇為 GPT-6 Astra 協助的標準模型晶格定義
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI launched its science blog on November 15 to share AI-assisted scientific work. The first guest post by physicist Nathaniel Craig describes how he worked with GPT-6 Astra on a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model, based on an October arXiv preprint; Astra helped develop the construction and detailed proof, which was reviewed with lattice theorists.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 11 月 15 日推出科學部落格，分享 AI 輔助科學研究。首篇客座文章由物理學家 Nathaniel Craig 撰寫，說明他與 GPT-6 Astra 合作，提出標準模型非微擾晶格定義候選方案（基於 10 月 arXiv 預印本）；Astra 協助將策略轉為建構並主導詳細證明，並經晶格理論專家審閱。
items_flat.analysis_en: This documents a concrete case of frontier models contributing to mathematical physics proofs rather than just writing assistance. Practical simulations and independent acceptance remain open, so the long-term impact depends on expert community uptake.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是前沿模型參與數學物理證明的具體案例，而非僅限寫作輔助。實用模擬與獨立接受度仍待觀察，長期影響取決於專家社群的採納程度。
items_flat.quote: Astra helped turn that strategy into a construction and took the lead in developing the detailed proof.
items_flat.quote_zh: Astra 協助將該策略轉為建構，並主導發展詳細證明。

items_flat.title_en: Meta releases Muse Ember, its smallest efficient model for agent tasks
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Ember，最小高效代理任務模型
items_flat.summary_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs introduced Muse Ember, a low-cost model ($0.10/$0.50 per million tokens) designed for high-volume agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, and long-document parsing. It is available on the Meta Model API.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs 推出 Muse Ember，低成本模型（每百萬 token $0.10/$0.50），專為高用量代理工作設計，如工具呼叫、編碼子任務、路由與長文件解析。已於 Meta Model API 提供。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ember targets the cheap worker role that pairs with larger frontier models. Cost leadership claims need independent verification against Haiku 5.5, Luna, and open models before it becomes the default choice.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Ember 瞄準與較大前沿模型搭配的廉價工作者角色。成本領先主張需對比 Haiku 5.5、Luna 與開源模型進行獨立驗證，才可能成為預設選擇。
items_flat.quote: Today, we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Muse Ember，我們最小、最高效的模型，專為複雜推理執行與代理全天重複的工作而設計。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic rolls out Claude Meetings beta for Google Meet
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Meetings beta，支援 Google Meet
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic began rolling out Claude Meetings in beta on Team and Enterprise plans. Claude joins Google Meet calls as a visible participant that follows the conversation, answers questions, takes notes, and builds docs or whiteboards in real time.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 開始在 Team 與 Enterprise 方案推出 Claude Meetings beta。Claude 以可見參與者身份加入 Google Meet 通話，跟隨對話、回答問題、做筆記，並即時建立文件或白板。
items_flat.analysis_en: The feature shifts Claude from post-meeting summarizer to in-meeting collaborator, limited for now to Google Meet and paid business plans. Adoption will depend on reliability of live understanding and artifact quality.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此功能將 Claude 從會後摘要工具轉為會議中協作者，目前僅限 Google Meet 與付費商業方案。採用程度取決於即時理解與產出品質的可靠性。
items_flat.quote: Claude can now join your video calls as a visible participant, follow the conversation and start on work during the meeting.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude現在可以可見參與者身分加入你的視訊通話，跟隨對話並在會議進行時開始工作。
